quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
quests.text: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Healthy Dragon Scale
quests.text: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.text: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.text: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.  Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
quests.text: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.text: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.text: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.text: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
quests.text: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

quests.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
quests.text: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
